CRM notes:
- Opportunity: Strata Guard Systems — payments fraud detection + customer support augmentation. Heavy compliance (PII + payment tokens).
- Deployment ask: Private VPC deployment in customer AWS accounts (VPC peering/VPN), customer-managed KMS (BYOK/HSM preferred), audit logs shipped to customer Splunk/SIEM, EMEA data residency for EU customers.
- Vendor intake: Received initial SIG (partial) on 2026-03-01. Risk team wants full CAIQ mapping; flagged areas: key rotation procedures, KMS key export controls, cross-region replication policies, retention policy for audit logs.
- Shared responsibility: Customer insists Redwood provides clear matrix showing: what lives in their VPC (inference nodes, KV cache optional), what Redwood controls (control plane metadata, model artifacts if hosted), and where logs/metrics are forwarded. Security asked for a signed statement that no plaintext model input is written to Redwood long-term storage unless customer opt-in.
- KMS: Customer requires envelope encryption where customer root key in their KMS never leaves their account. They want runbook for BYOK rotation and an HSM proof-of-concept to confirm latency impact on token generation. SE note: need to show latency benchmarks with customer KMS callouts (p50/p95).
- Audit logging + retention: 7 year retention for certain transaction logs; realtime streaming to customer SIEM (Splunk) and S3 archiving in eu-west-1. Need to document log schema and PII redaction options.
- Models & performance: Primary workloads: short-chat customer support (p50 target 80-120ms downstream), embeddings for fraud feature store (throughput 10k/day), reranking batch jobs overnight. Customer prefers open models (Llama/Mistral family) that Redwood can quantize and pin. Ask: fallback policy between hosted variant and private quantized model during failover.
- Commercials: Procurement is price sensitive; looking at a 3-year committed Dedicated pricing or Private subscription. Estimated ARR target in their business case: $300k/yr.
- Quotes from customer: CIO "We must retain custody of all keys and be able to audit any external access." Security lead: "Provide CAIQ or equivalent mapping — we cannot accept blank cells."
- Action items: produce completed SIG + CAIQ mapping by 2026-03-15 (AE/SE), build BYOK runbook and KMS latency test plan (SE), coordinate HSM PoC scheduling with customer infra (CSM/SE), prepare legal redline playbook for data residency clauses (AE + legal).
- Risks: if SIG gaps not closed, procurement will pause; legal negotiation may extend to Q2.
